note: 0.1.7 D-81: cmd/log.pl keeps <state>/<plugin>/cache/<sid>.v1.json from the mod's main keep_warm_start/ping/stop and compacted rows (temp + rename, 0600). `cache` adds keep-warm: ↻n/max while active (max = floor((hours*60-1)/50): 7 at 6 h, 1 at 1 h, 0 at 0.5 h), the last stop. A ping counts only if it started (ts - ms) after the last main request (critique 3): a warm one moves the 1h expiry to its start + 1 h, else Claude Code's later prompt_cache.expires_at stands (probe Q2: a fork that reads the cache moves it itself); a stale ping before a later 5m main request changes nothing; a ping that failed after a warm one (api-error, error) leaves that warm one's expiry (review 2 of the cache lane); a fork-miss after it reads cold (probe Q3: 17 of 17 next main requests missed). A compaction after the last request reads cold until the next one; a skipped compaction or a subagent's does not count, nor an idle_compact row (idle.ts writes it before it tries plugin idle compaction, which may then be skipped or never run; review of the cache fix: the status line read `cache cold (compacted)` while warm). Out-of-order rows change nothing; a stop with no start row (no-idle-path) is a gap of its own; a torn file reads unknown, exit 0; parallel writers leave valid JSON.

steps.name: keep_warm_start and a warm ping (n 1)
the ping alone (no transcript, no stdin): warm on the 1h tier, keep-warm 1/7
json: the ping is the last request; next due 50 min after it
prompt_cache older than the ping (a version that does not touch it): the ping's expiry
prompt_cache's expires_at later than the ping (Claude Code's own touch): it stands
prompt_cache without a transcript: the ping ended within 5 s of expires_at - ttl, so it counts
a stale ping before a later 5m main request: ignored
an older ping row after the newer one (another writer): nothing changes
a second warm ping, then a fork-miss
a fork-miss after the last main request: cold
json: cold, fork-miss, n 2
keep_warm_stop why fork-miss
after the stop: not active, the stop's reason
a main request after the fork-miss: warm again from it
a warm ping, then a ping that failed (api-error) 50 min later, in one gap
the failed ping does not undo the warm one: warm until its start + 1 h (transcript, no prompt_cache)
then a ping that ended in an error
json: the warm ping stays the last request; last_result error
compacted after that request; one skipped and a subagent's later do not count
a compaction after the last request: cold, compacted
the next main request after the compaction: warm
idle_compact, then that compaction skipped (too-small): nothing recorded, no state file
so the cache still reads warm, not compacted
an idle_compact row alone (the process ended before the compaction): nothing recorded
still warm
then the compaction's own row (it ran): compacted
cold, compacted
a stop with no start row (no-idle-path): a gap of its own
no-idle-path: not active, n 0, max unknown
keep_warm_hours 1
max 1 at 1 h, no ping yet: 0 of 1
keep_warm_hours 0.5
max 0 at 0.5 h
a gap whose stop row never came (a crash): inactive past the 58-minute bound
a torn state file: unknown, exit 0
a torn file is replaced by the next row
8 writers at once: the file stays one valid JSON object, no temp file left
